description: This file defines configuration options for activation count-based placement of grains in Orleans, including a class for options and a validator class to ensure valid configuration.

classes.name: ActivationCountBasedPlacementOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration settings for activation count-based grain placement, including the number of silos to consider.

classes.name: ActivationCountBasedPlacementOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the properties of ActivationCountBasedPlacementOptions to ensure they meet required constraints.

methods.name: ActivationCountBasedPlacementOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with options.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
